required_receipts.command: pinned checkout plus complete source/dependency/asset license scan
required_receipts.pass_condition: permitted licenses, captured attribution, no unknown/disallowed files

required_receipts.command: bounded source extraction and provider/token/data boundary review
required_receipts.pass_condition: no direct provider SDK, hardcoded palette, block write, or unowned file

required_receipts.command: target host install and build using the recorded lockfile
required_receipts.pass_condition: clean exit in the target host with the block enabled

required_receipts.command: fixture-session browser smoke for /dashboard/main with mutation observation
required_receipts.pass_condition: chart/table render and no POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE caused by the block

required_receipts.command: reproducible fixture capture and visual comparison
required_receipts.pass_condition: baseline hash, renderer, threshold, and result are recorded

required_receipts.command: assign host owner and execute scoped rollback/dry-run
required_receipts.pass_condition: prior state restores without unrelated file/data deletion
accepted only when every required gate passes

verdict_rule: Any not_run, failed, unknown, or incomplete gate forces held; only all-pass G1-G6 permits accepted.
execution_boundary: No checkout, install, build, browser run, screenshot, license scan, runtime edit, shared schema edit, or merged artifact edit was performed while writing this plan.
